cli.description: Vlog editing assistant: folder input → compress → AI analysis → voiceover → plan
cli.help.force: Ignore existing outputs and regenerate (overrides config.yaml skip_existing)
cli.help.io.force: Ignore existing outputs and regenerate (overrides config.yaml skip_existing)
cli.help.compress: Compress videos in the source folder only
cli.help.analyze: Compress and run AI analysis; emit text and CSV
cli.help.scripts: Generate voiceover scripts from analysis results
cli.help.label: Burn sequence labels into compressed videos
cli.help.check: Check whether the environment is ready
cli.help.doctor: Diagnose the local environment, dependencies, configuration, and common runtime risks
cli.help.plan: Generate a single-day vlog editing plan
cli.help.plan.all_days: Generate multi-day plans from day/day_label values in analysis results
cli.help.plan.no_transcripts: Do not inject transcripts into the prompt
cli.help.run: Run the full pipeline in one command
cli.help.cut: Cut clips from videos according to the plan
cli.help.cut.force: Ignore plan readiness warnings (errors still block)
cli.help.cut.reencode: Re-encode for precise cuts (default: fast -c copy)
cli.help.cut.source: Video source (compressed: cut compressed copies / original: cut originals)
cli.help.refine: Review and correct existing analysis/scripts with AI and trip context
cli.help.refine.input: Single .json file or directory; omit to process all texts/ or scripts/
cli.help.refine.fix: Specific correction (requires a single file with -i). Example: --fix 'change location from Bangkok Suvarnabhumi to Paris Charles de Gaulle'
cli.help.refine.context: Temporary context appended after ai.context (this refine run only)
cli.help.compare: Analyze one video with multiple video models and generate a comparison report
cli.help.compare.models: Model list in provider:model format; comma-separated values are also accepted
cli.help.compare.context: Temporary context appended after ai.context (this comparison only)
cli.help.migrate_config: Scan existing project.yaml files and add missing provider configuration fields
cli.help.migrate_config.projects_root: Projects root (scan project.yaml files in subdirectories)
cli.help.migrate: Migrate old projects to the new layout (separate project_dir + videos.json)
cli.help.migrate.from: Project path to migrate (default: scan the registry)
cli.help.serve: Start the local web UI for visual editing of AI output
cli.help.serve.host: Listen address (default: 127.0.0.1; not exposed to the LAN)
cli.help.serve.no_browser: Do not open a browser automatically
cli.help.desktop: Start the desktop window (pywebview + local UI with native file dialogs)
cli.help.export: Export a plan to an editing-software draft
cli.help.export.force: Ignore plan readiness warnings (errors still block)
cli.help.verify: Verify the integrity of compressed files and their originals
cli.help.reindex.name: Match by project name (optional; -p/--project takes precedence)
cli.help.transcribe: Whisper ASR transcription (faster-whisper must be installed)
cli.help.whisper.install: Install faster-whisper dependencies and pre-download the model
